scope: Bounded independent review of all 38 intermediate strong candidates (therefore all current 32 strong), nine additional initial strong cases, two parent risk checks, all 16 priority supplements, their known counterexamples and the clearly separated Metropole/Gascogne main buildings. Decisions are by candidateId, not mutable classifier output; unreviewed 498-candidate tail is not approved.
methodology: Names and proximity produce candidates, not identity proof. Original source names and address/property range were inspected.
Existing same-site/rebuilt constraints and persistent holds are binding until independently resolved.
Accepted links mean the same named listed property; they do not assert all construction dates, historical uses, footprints or reference-point precision are identical.
No source records, source coordinates or source UI files were changed by this review.
UI now distinguishes listed buildings, complexes and structures. Four confirmed entire-complex objects are approved only with explicit relation/scopeNote; two complex identities remain unresolved.
Each approved card preserves source dates and addresses separately. Date conflicts indicating relocation/rebuilding trigger holds (HSBC 1874/1923, Qingxin1860/1923).
No tie between competing VS records is broken only by distance. Guangxue503/1680 and Taikoo5/1235 require source grouping before common-card configuration.
